picks.title: OpenObserve v1.0: GA with AI Observability for Agents
picks.summary: Open-source observability platform hits 1.0, headlined by AI Observability: agent tracing, LLM monitoring, evals, and session annotation unified with logs, metrics, traces, and RUM.
picks.implementation_idea: Self-host OpenObserve and point the Muse/Hermes/Codex agent stack's traces at it: per-agent token-cost dashboards and failure-point maps for the local deployment, replacing ad-hoc cost tracking.
picks.reason: Strongest build idea in the feed

picks.title: OmniRoute
picks.summary: Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers and 500+ models with quota-aware auto-fallback.
picks.implementation_idea: Front the OpenRouter JEV calls with OmniRoute for provider fallback and token-compression savings.
picks.reason: Strongest build idea in the feed

picks.title: opencodex
picks.summary: Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code: use any LLM with Codex CLI, App, SDK, and Claude Code.
picks.implementation_idea: Run Codex against cheaper local models via opencodex for routine refactors.
picks.reason: Strongest build idea in the feed

picks.title: Claude Opus 5.5
picks.summary: First of the Claude 5.5 family at $4/$20 per M tokens, now the default Opus in Claude Code.
picks.implementation_idea: Switch the Hermes reviewer agent to Opus 5.5 for a week and measure cost and quality deltas.
picks.reason: Strongest build idea in the feed
